To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the exogenous shock to emerging market liberalization is associated with higher levels of international JV stability, 2) international JV partners show high levels of complementarity of partner resource, 3) international JVs show higher levels of stability in industries where the partners have a higher degree of technological and market related resources complementarity, 4) international JVs are more stable in emerging markets than in developed markets.

1) international JVs show positive market reactions to emerging market liberalizations; 2) international JVs have high levels of complementarity of partners’ resources; 3) international JVs are able to alleviate the problems of stability.
the exogenous shocks of emerging market liberalizations have a positive impact on stability of international J.V.s in developed markets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of international strategic alliances between emerging economies and developed economies.
the following issues: 1) What is the impact of emerging market firms on the value of developed market firms in the context of a joint venture?
the following questions: (1) Do international JVs improve value in developed markets?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
international JVs are an effective instrument for the value creation of the firms involved.

- the international JV is a strategic tool for firms operating in developed countries, which allows to increase their competitiveness and improve their performance in international markets; - the emerging market liberalization is a positive factor for the stability of international JV; - the complementarity of resources between partners is a positive factor that can alleviate the instability of international JV; the international JV is an instrument for value creation for firms operating in developing and emerging countries, but the creation of value is not only due to the international JV,
the international JVs in the emerging market have been successful in creating value, but they are still a challenge for the firms operating in the emerging market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
International JVs are a valuable source of information for investors and a useful instrument for the development of emerging markets.
the international JVs are a positive phenomenon for value creation.
international JVs have been able to create value, and that this value creation is positively related to the stability of the JVs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the international JVs in the developed markets are a source of value creation.
the emerging market partners are able to provide a positive shock to the stability of the JVs, and to improve the performance of their partners.
emerging market firms are able to improve the performance of developed market firms.
